review:
9 Balls is a football-themed Hold the Jackpot game from Wazdan, played on 9 reels in a stadium setting. It uses the studio's familiar formula with sports-themed names: Cash Infinity symbols are worth more and stay on the reels until the end of the next bonus round.

The Penalty Kick label is the base-game feature: once it attaches to a reel and its countdown reaches zero, it awards a prize. xG Chance Level is Wazdan's bet multiplier under a football name, raising the stake to make the respin bonus more likely. Wazdan publishes a 96.04% RTP, high volatility and a 2,500x max win. It is a straightforward pick for football fans who like jackpot-style respins rather than complex mechanics.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots

cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
